form.label: CAO & DAR — Focused Incident Investigation Console v8.1
form.description: Rebuilt from the stable v6.6 dashboard for fast, guided L2/L3 troubleshooting. The console runs only the searches needed for the selected investigation view and keeps REST API, workload, evidence, context and trends separate to reduce clutter and search load.

init.set: No event selected — click an evidence row to open ±5-minute context

panel.html:
Focused Incident Investigation Console
Application: $selected_project_label$  |  Platform: $platform_type$  |  Project / Scope: $project_namespace$  |  Index: $selected_index$  |  $investigation_view_label$
Choose the investigation area, apply only the filters you need, then click Submit. Start with 30 minutes; expand the time range only after isolating the workload, endpoint or correlation ID.

search.query: index="$selected_index$" sourcetype="$selected_sourcetype$" | fields _time _raw host hostname source sourcetype message body level severity severityText applicationName app namespace project pod_name container_name datacenter dc site status status_code statusCode http_status httpStatus respStatus responseStatus responseCode response_code kubernetes | addinfo | spath | eval source_project=coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name','kubernetes.namespace',namespace,project) | where "$platform_type$"="VM" OR source_project="$project_namespace$" | eval application=coalesce('message.applicationName',applicationName,app,'kubernetes.labels.app','kubernetes.labels.app_kubernetes_io/name','kubernetes.container_name','kubernetes.container',"$selected_project_label$") | eval pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name','kubernetes.pod',pod_name,hostname,host,"Unknown") | eval container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name','kubernetes.container',container_name,"Unknown") | eval node=coalesce('kubernetes.node_name','kubernetes.host',host,hostname,"Unknown") | eval raw_dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,dc,site,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.dc',node,pod,host,hostname)) | eval datacenter=case(match(raw_dc,"GAR04P|(^|[-_])GAR([-_]|$)"),"GAR",match(raw_dc,"MAN04P|(^|[-_])MAN([-_]|$)"),"MAN",match(raw_dc,"STR04P|(^|[-_])STR([-_]|$)"),"STR",match(raw_dc,"LEW04P|(^|[-_])LEW([-_]|$)"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | eval log_level=upper(coalesce('message.level',level,severity,severityText,"UNKNOWN")) | eval log_level=case(match(log_level,"ERR|FATAL|SEVERE"),"ERROR",match(log_level,"WARN"),"WARN",match(log_level,"INFO"),"INFO",match(log_level,"DEBUG|TRACE"),"DEBUG",true(),log_level) | eval log_text=coalesce('message.body',body,message,_raw) | eval status_candidate=coalesce('message.http_status','message.httpStatus','message.status','message.status_code','message.statusCode','message.respStatus','message.responseStatus','message.responseCode','message.response_code',http_status,httpStatus,status,status_code,statusCode,respStatus,responseStatus,responseCode,response_code) | rex field=status_candidate max_match=1 "(?<status_from_structured>[1-5][0-9]{2})" | rex field=log_text max_match=1 "(?i)(?:resp(?:onse)?[_ -]?status|http[_ -]?status|status(?:Code)?|response(?:Code)?|httpStatus|HTTP(?:/[0-9.]+)?)[^0-9]{0,40}(?<status_from_text>[1-5][0-9]{2})" | rex field=log_text max_match=1 "(?i)(?:HttpClientErrorException|HttpServerErrorException|WebClientResponseException|unauthorized|forbidden|bad request|not found|too many requests|internal server error|bad gateway|service unavailable|gateway timeout)[^0-9]{0,80}(?<status_from_exception>400|401|403|404|405|408|409|415|422|429|500|501|502|503|504)" | rex field=log_text max_match=1 "(?i)\b(?<status_before_label>400|401|403|404|405|408|409|415|422|429|500|501|502|503|504)\b[^A-Za-z]{0,20}(?:bad request|unauthorized|forbidden|not found|method not allowed|request timeout|conflict|unsupported media type|unprocessable entity|too many requests|internal server error|not implemented|bad gateway|service unavailable|gateway timeout)" | eval http_status=tostring(coalesce(status_from_structured,status_from_text,status_from_exception,status_before_label)) | eval http_status=if(match(http_status,"^[1-5][0-9]{2}$"),http_status,null()) | eval is_http_event=if(isnotnull(http_status),1,0) | eval is_http_200=if(http_status="200",1,0) | eval is_http_success=if(tonumber(http_status)>=200 AND tonumber(http_status)<300,1,0) | eval is_http_4xx=if(tonumber(http_status)>=400 AND tonumber(http_status)<500,1,0) | eval is_http_5xx=if(tonumber(http_status)>=500 AND tonumber(http_status)<600,1,0) | eval is_rest_api_error=if(match(log_text,"(?i)REST_API_CALL_ERROR|HttpServerErrorException|HttpClientErrorException|WebClientResponseException") OR is_http_4xx=1 OR is_http_5xx=1,1,0) | eval is_database_error=if(match(log_text,"(?i)SQLServerException|SQLException|deadlock|JDBC|connection pool exhausted|database connection"),1,0) | eval is_batch_error=if(match(log_text,"(?i)afterJob|beforeJob|JobExecution|StepExecution|status=FAILED|exitStatus=FAILED") AND match(log_text,"(?i)FAILED|Exception encountered|rollback"),1,0) | eval is_rollback_error=if(match(log_text,"(?i)rollback|TransactionRollbackException|UnexpectedRollbackException"),1,0) | eval is_timeout=if(match(log_text,"(?i)timeout|timed out|SocketTimeout|ReadTimeout|ConnectTimeout"),1,0) | eval is_auth_error=if(http_status="401" OR http_status="403" OR match(log_text,"(?i)authentication failed|authorization failed|unauthorized|forbidden|invalid token|expired token"),1,0) | eval is_platform_error=if(match(log_text,"(?i)OOMKilled|OutOfMemoryError|out of memory|CrashLoopBackOff|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|Evicted"),1,0) | eval is_connection_error=if(match(log_text,"(?i)connection refused|connection reset|no route to host|broken pipe|Service Unavailable"),1,0) | eval is_actionable_error=if(is_rest_api_error=1 OR is_database_error=1 OR is_batch_error=1 OR is_rollback_error=1 OR is_timeout=1 OR is_auth_error=1 OR is_platform_error=1 OR is_connection_error=1 OR log_level="ERROR",1,0) | eval event_category=case(is_platform_error=1,"Pod / Platform Error",is_rollback_error=1,"Transaction Rollback",is_batch_error=1,"Batch Failure",is_database_error=1,"Database Error",is_timeout=1,"Timeout",is_auth_error=1,"Authentication Error",is_connection_error=1,"Connection Error",is_rest_api_error=1,"REST API Error",log_level="ERROR","Application Error",true(),"Normal") | eval status_family=case(is_http_success=1,"2xx",tonumber(http_status)>=300 AND tonumber(http_status)<400,"3xx",is_http_4xx=1,"4xx",is_http_5xx=1,"5xx",true(),"No Status") | eval text_filter_value=lower($text_filter|s$), pod_filter_value=lower($pod_filter|s$) | where ($datacenter|s$="*" OR datacenter=$datacenter|s$) AND (pod_filter_value="*" OR pod_filter_value="" OR like(lower(pod),"%".pod_filter_value."%")) AND (text_filter_value="*" OR text_filter_value="" OR like(lower(application),"%".text_filter_value."%") OR like(lower(pod),"%".text_filter_value."%") OR like(lower(log_text),"%".text_filter_value."%")) | eval http_status=coalesce(http_status,"N/A"), event_time=_time | bin _time span=1m | stats count AS Events sum(is_actionable_error) AS Error_Events sum(is_http_event) AS HTTP_Events sum(is_http_200) AS HTTP_200 sum(is_http_success) AS HTTP_Success sum(is_http_4xx) AS HTTP_4xx sum(is_http_5xx) AS HTTP_5xx sum(is_rest_api_error) AS REST_Errors sum(is_database_error) AS DB_Errors sum(is_batch_error) AS Batch_Errors sum(is_rollback_error) AS Rollback_Errors sum(is_timeout) AS Timeout_Errors sum(is_auth_error) AS Auth_Errors sum(is_platform_error) AS Platform_Errors sum(is_connection_error) AS Connection_Errors latest(event_time) AS Last_Seen max(info_max_time) AS Search_End by _time datacenter application pod http_status status_family event_category | eval Search_End=if(Search_End>now(),now(),Search_End), HTTP_Failures=HTTP_Events-HTTP_Success

panel.html: 60-second triage: confirm log freshness → review severity and affected workload count → open the newest actionable error → move to Evidence & Context only when deeper proof is required. This view intentionally avoids long workload-name lists.

search.query: | stats sum(Error_Events) AS value | eval value=coalesce(value,0)
| stats sum(HTTP_5xx) AS value | eval value=coalesce(value,0)
| stats sum(HTTP_4xx) AS value | eval value=coalesce(value,0)
| where Error_Events>0 | stats dc(pod) AS value | eval value=coalesce(value,0)
| stats max(Last_Seen) AS Last_Seen max(Search_End) AS Search_End | eval value=round((Search_End-Last_Seen)/60,1) | fields value

| stats sum(Error_Events) AS Errors sum(HTTP_4xx) AS HTTP_4xx sum(HTTP_5xx) AS HTTP_5xx sum(REST_Errors) AS REST_Errors sum(DB_Errors) AS DB_Errors sum(Connection_Errors) AS Connection_Errors sum(Timeout_Errors) AS Timeouts sum(Platform_Errors) AS Platform_Errors dc(pod) AS Reporting_Workloads max(Last_Seen) AS Last_Seen max(Search_End) AS Search_End | eval Minutes_Since_Last_Log=round((Search_End-Last_Seen)/60,1) | eval Status=case(Minutes_Since_Last_Log>15,"NO FRESH LOGS",HTTP_5xx>0 OR Platform_Errors>0,"CRITICAL",Errors>0,"DEGRADED",true(),"NO ACTIONABLE ERRORS") | eval Primary_Finding=case(Platform_Errors>0,"Pod / platform failure evidence",HTTP_5xx>0,"Server-side REST/API failures",DB_Errors>0,"Database failures",Connection_Errors>0 OR Timeouts>0,"Connection or timeout failures",HTTP_4xx>0,"Client/authentication REST failures",Errors>0,"Application errors",true(),"No actionable errors in selected scope") | eval Recommended_Next_Step=case(Status="NO FRESH LOGS","Confirm Splunk ingestion and runtime state before declaring healthy",Platform_Errors>0,"Open Workload / VM Host view",REST_Errors>0 OR HTTP_4xx>0 OR HTTP_5xx>0,"Open REST API Calls view",Errors>0,"Open Evidence & Context view",true(),"No incident action required") | eval Last_Log=strftime(Last_Seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table Status Primary_Finding Errors HTTP_4xx HTTP_5xx Reporting_Workloads Last_Log Minutes_Since_Last_Log Recommended_Next_Step

panel.html:
L2/L3 Troubleshooting Flow

1 — Confirm scope: verify application, data center and time range. Start at 30 minutes.

2 — Validate freshness: stale or missing logs do not prove the application is healthy or unhealthy. Confirm runtime state separately when needed.

3 — Choose one path: use REST API Calls for endpoint/status issues; Workload / VM Host for pod or host concentration; Evidence & Context for correlation and raw proof.

4 — Narrow before expanding: filter to one pod, endpoint or correlation ID before moving from 30 minutes to four or 24 hours.

5 — Export evidence: export the bounded evidence table or open the search in Splunk. Include application, data center, pod/host, first/last seen, endpoint/status, correlation ID and a redacted sample message.

Escalate with facts: state the likely layer and blast radius. Avoid pasting hundreds of workload names or unredacted raw payloads.
